plain: The basic ideas or facts on which something is built.

webster.text: The work which forms the foundation or support of any thing; the basis; the fundamentals.

more.text: The ground; that to which the rest are additional.

example.quote: I am afraid I have tired the patience of this house ; but I trust you will pardon me, as I was urged by the importunity of the gentleman in calling for the reasons of laying the groundwork of this plan.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
